summary.shape: front facets planar: face_slope ~constant (0.18-0.23) from the widest point to the bark, i.e. the ridge falls in proportion to the half-width toward the tip; rear steeper (0.24-0.33 toward the shoulder), consistent with a ridge held at constant height from the shoulder to the widest crease (the same structure as our spec, 2x deeper)

lod1_is_distinct.note: LODs are authored by the kunai generator at their own counts, not decimated: fewer blade stations, a 10-sided grip with plain collar steps (LOD1) or an 8-sided grip without collars (LOD2), a coarser ring; LOD2's cutting edges are the edge line (land 0), its neck edges square and its ring section square. Every LOD keeps the lettering band's mesh lines. Deviation is two-sided.

UCX_00.parts: blade and bare front neck (the head shell, x >= -6.5 mm)

UCX_01.parts: wrap, rear neck and ring (x <= -6 mm)

render_gates.beauty_source: baked textures only: every material slot through its own baked-map preview material

hero_coat_dark.rule: flat coat steel does not read as a hole: dark pixels are a wall's business, not the plate's

top_coat_dark.rule: flat coat steel does not read as a hole: dark pixels are a wall's business, not the plate's

hero_coat.note: pixels of flat faces (|N.z| >= 0.95) that are not a bar's ground surfaces: a star's plate, a bar's up-facing faces - the coat under the same light (pack_consistency, like with like)

top_coat.note: pixels of flat faces (|N.z| >= 0.95) that are not a bar's ground surfaces: a star's plate, a bar's up-facing faces - the coat under the same light (pack_consistency, like with like)

uv_consistency.method: LOD1..n UV0 from LOD0's island maps (shuriken_lib.uv); one texture set for every LOD
uv_consistency.island_map_deviation_note: information: per-loop distance of every LODn UV from the affine map of its LOD0 island (uv.transfer_uvs island_map_deviation)

knife_shading.note: max angle between a stored corner normal and its own face normal over the knife facets (flat facets shaded flat: creases above geometry.KNIFE_CREASE_DEG inside a knife class are hard edges). Curved-side facets (senban) are smooth within their side by design and bounded by half a chord's turn; they are reported, not gated.

SM_Kunai_Plain_LOD0.note: aspect = longest edge^2 / area.  The knife lands (0.15 mm tall, several mm long), the wall strips and the wrap caps' fans are long by design; nothing is degenerate (qa_check's 1 um / 1 um2)
